Written beside a test catalog, they identify and describe both releases offline; rex reads no TMDB.

Metadata.summary: Several strangers converge on a hotel in Venice, Italy, where a bellboy's bad English sets them up to clash against each other in a hilarious case of mistaken identity.
Metadata.tagline: Mix-ups, Mishaps, Madness, and Mayhem... It's all part of the service.
Metadata.title: Blame It on the Bellboy

Summary.tag: Names, mail and missions of three men (Dudley Moore, Bryan Brown, Richard Griffiths) get confused.

Metadata.summary: The escapades of Stan Smith, a conservative C.I.A. Agent dealing with family life, while keeping America safe.
Metadata.tagline: From the creator of "Family Guy" comes a man who will stop at nothing to protect his country.
Metadata.title: American Dad!

CommonSenseMedia.oneLiner: Absurd sitcom mocks family life with sex, drugs, violence.

Metadata.summary: Special installments of the series.
Metadata.title: Specials

Metadata.summary: From the delightfully twisted creative minds behind 'Family Guy' comes 'American Dad', the animated tour de force featuring CIA operative Stan Smith, his outrageous family and Roger, the alcoholic extraterrestrial who lives with them! Follow the adventures of the Smiths from the California desert, where Stan's wife, Francine, relives her teenage years at the Burning Man festival, to Saudi Arabia, where the entire family is sentenced to death by the Vice and Virtue Police! Whether it's rigging elections, erasing memories, casing sleazy strip clubs, or staging "bum fights", it's all in a day's work for Stan, and it's all here in the side-splittingly hilarious first season of 'American Dad'!
Metadata.title: Season 1

Metadata.summary: Terrorists (and all you bed-wetting hippie-liberal types) beware! Ultra-right-wing C.I.A. agent Stan Smith is back, taking names, and, well, you know the rest. Join Stan, along with his hilariously off-beat family, as he spans the globe to make the world safe for democracy! If you are ready to support your country, and if you're ready for a widly outrageous animated farce from Mike Barker, Matt Weitzman and Seth MacFarlane, the creative mastermind behind Family Guy, you're ready for American Dad! Volume two. God bless America.
Metadata.title: Season 2

Metadata.summary: C.I.A. weapons expert Stan Smith is back, keeping the homeland secure while alienating his family and terrorising his neighbours in the process. Whether he's saddling up for a mad cow cattle drive or destroying evidence of President Bush's drunken debauchery, Stan does whatever it takes to ensure domestic tranquility and make the world safe for democracy of the ultra-right-wing variety! Join the Smith family and Roger, their alcoholic pet alien, for this hilarious Volume Three of 'American Dad!' God Bless America!
Metadata.title: Season 3

Metadata.summary: Attention, terrorists, pinkos, and hippies: your days are numbered! CIA Agent Stan Smith is back, stopping at nothing to make the world safe for right-wing democracy and provide for his outrageously dysfunctional extended family. Amid botched kidnappings and beefcake body doubles, Stan hosts a torturously funny CIA telethon; his wife, Francine, is reunited with her ex-fiance; and resident-alien Roger hosts a booze-soaked spring break that may just push favorite son Steve all the way through puberty. God bless American Dad!
Metadata.title: Season 4

Metadata.summary: The hilarious, over-the-top adventures of CIA Agent Stan Smith - a red-white-and-blue-blooded, one-man war on terror - and his delightfully dysfunctional family. Volume Five celebrates that great American pastime - revenge! Steve and his friends strike back at Bar Mitzvah boy - Etan Cohen for stealing Steve's girlfriend, Francine puts Stan through the ringer when she finds out he's picked a back-up wife, and Roger unleashes deadly hotdog havoc throughout Langley Falls - all in the name of good old-fashioned vengeance. Getting even is the American way, so don't get mad...get American Dad!
Metadata.title: Season 5

Metadata.summary: Trigger-happy CIA operative Stan Smith will stop at nothing to defend everything that makes this country great – from strip bars to that most sacred of American institutions, crack cocaine! Whether he's trading brains with a racehorse or rescuing Roger from bloodthirsty revolutionaries, Stan will do whatever it takes to secure the blessings of liberty in this over-the-top salute to the greatest nation on Earth.
Metadata.title: Season 6

Metadata.summary: It's a time once again to let it all hang out with an all-new volume of animated outrageousness! From the disturbed comic minds of Mike Barker, Matt Weitzman, and Family Guy creator Seth MacFarlane, comes the always insane adventures of CIA operative Stan Smith and his wonderfully twisted family. In the 100th episode, Hayley elopes with Jeff! Other episodes include Stan on jury duty, Steve walking in on his amorous parents, Roger dating Steve's best friend, and yet another American Dad Christmas classic. Plus, there are serial killers, Turkish amphetamines, and evil clones! So, you know, the usual!
Metadata.title: Season 7

Metadata.summary: Let your American freak flag fly when you watch this all-new collection of outrageous episodes from the comic minds of Mike Barker, Matt Weitzman and Family Guy creator Seth MacFarlane. Follow the adventures of CIA operative Stan Smith's quirky family as they deal with Stan and Francine's killer hot tub, Steve's lucky panties, Hayley and Jeff adopting an evil child, and Roger wrestling his way into the record books. Loaded with celebrity guest voices, including Sarah Michelle Gellar, CeeLo Green, Alyson Hannigan, Patrick Stewart, Amy Sedaris and more, American Dad! Volume 8 is a star-powered salute to patriotic parody and hardcore hilarity!
Metadata.title: Season 8

Metadata.summary: Take a “Stan" against boring, bipartisan comedy with this all-new collection of hilariousuncensored American Dadl episodes from the infinitely creative minds of Mike Barker, Matt Weitzman and Family Guy creator Seth MacFarlane. This outrageous assortment finds Stan and Klaus switching bodies, Steve joining a boy band, Jeff being held prisoner in space, and Roger falling hard for his latest crush...Hayley!
Metadata.title: Season 9

Metadata.summary: Belly-laugh up to the bar, folks… and satisfy your thirst for hilarity with the all-new collection of uncensored American Dad! episodes from the spirited minds of Mike Barker, Matt Weitzman and Family Guy creator Seth MacFarlane. Loaded with celebrity guest voices, including Mariah Carey, Terry Crews, Mark Cuban, Zooey Deschanel, Danny Glover and Olivia Wilde, this intoxicating assortment finds Stan fired from the CIA, Francine haunted by a sex-starved ghost, Steve kidnapped by a Christmas demon, and Roger and Klaus on a 100,000-mile road trip. Please watch responsibly.
Metadata.title: Season 10

Metadata.summary: Get ready for full-scale hilarity and huge laughs with this all-new collection of American Dad! episodes from the comically oversized minds of Mike Barker, Matt Weitzman and Family Guy Creator Seth MacFarlane. Bulging with celebrity guest voices, including Kristin Chenoweth, Ted Danson, Kim Kardashian, Dean Norris, Mickey Rooney and Uma Thurman, this outrageous assortment finds Stan miniaturized after seeing a shrink, Steve embraces his inner lesbian, Roger crushing on a crash-landed alien , and the return of Jeff from space?.
Metadata.title: Season 12

Metadata.summary: Run for your lives! Or better yet, "Stan" your ground and enjoy this all-new collection of American Dad! episodes from the explosive comic minds of Mike Barker, Matt Weitzman and Family Guy creator Seth MacFarlane. Stuffed with celebrity guest voices, including Billy Bob Thornton, Joan Cusack, Sam Elliott, Oliver Platt, and not heavy metal rock god James Hetfield, this hilarious assortmend finds the Smith family in a flood of trouble aboard Stan's modern-day ark, a time-travelling Steve trying to save his cool future self, Roger deciding to quit all his personas, and everyone fighting to survive the post-apocalyptic 200th episode.
Metadata.title: Season 13

Metadata.summary: Celebrate the wit, wisdom and wild absurdity of your favorite all-American family with this all-new collection of American Dad! episodes. Crammed with celebrity guest voices, including Susan Sarandon, Jennifer Coolidge, Alfred Molina, Allison Janney and Danny Trejo, this sidesplitting assortment finds Stan shooting his mouth off in the Old West, Francine transformed into a sexy super-spy, Steve spellbound by a book of witchcraft, Jeff reborn as a full human, and Roger having a very fishy affair...with Klaus!
Metadata.title: Season 14

Metadata.summary: The episodes feature wild, surreal misadventures—including Steve trying baseball to connect with Stan, Snot getting rich off his mom's new dipping sauce ("Mom Sauce"), Stan joining a secret ham club, Roger running various chaotic personas and schemes, Snot discovering his father was a demolition derby driver, and time travel or alien/sci-fi escapades.
Metadata.title: Season 16

Metadata.summary: CIA agent Stan Smith continues navigating his extreme, over-the-patriotic approach to homeland security alongside his unorthodox family in Langley Falls, Virginia: doting wife Francine, liberal daughter Hayley, awkward son Steve, German-skier-brained goldfish Klaus, and eccentric alien Roger.
Metadata.title: Season 17

Metadata.summary: Episodes feature heavier fourth-wall breaking, alternative openings (such as Stan's modified morning routine near Groff Community College), and playful call-backs to running gags like "Ricky Spanish". Stan takes the family to a buffet that turns out to be a trap set by CIA scientist Dr. Weitzman, while Roger copes with stress by turning into a flower (which gets bought by a woman cheating on her husband).
Metadata.title: Season 18

Metadata.summary: Stan, Francine, and Roger plan to rob a bank, only to agree never to actually go through with it, leading to a strange exploration of family dynamics. Hayley and Jeff take a staycation at a luxury resort while the CIA undergoes a forced rebranding. Stan and Steve look into a dangerous Roger persona's past while Francine, Jeff, and Hayley pick up new hobbies (featuring guest star Michael Imperioli). A non-canonical early 20th-century historical epic following aspiring inventor Stan as he leaves the farm for the big city.
Metadata.title: Season 19

Metadata.summary: The Smith family hosts a disastrous backyard pool party disrupted by a dead rat while Roger unleashes his chaotic "Ricky Spanish" persona. Klaus tries to feel less left out by putting a man's mind into a snail, while Stan becomes an unhinged reality TV star. Snot and Klaus clash in a bizarre arc involving a cat cafe, Roger working as "Marmalade," and a rivalry over a father figure named Dell. Steve and his friends break into the Ministry of Tests after a meteor with a volcano on top threatens Earth.
Metadata.title: Season 20

Metadata.summary: Set in an alternate, early 20th-century historical universe (homaging classic silent films and Charlie Chaplin's Modern Times), the story departs from the traditional Langley Falls CIA setting. Stan invents a mechanical talking bug/sound device that brings audio to the world, making him wealthy and a rival to business moguls like Roger and Bullock. He later attempts to build a device to turn a black-and-white world into color, only to be ruined when Steve and Hayley activate it, forcing him to return to the farm with his mother, Betty.
Metadata.title: Season 21

Metadata.summary: This season centers on the 400th milestone episode, in which CIA agent Stan Smith survives a dangerous mission only to discover that the CIA has already replaced him with a clone when he returns home to find his duplicate living his life. The season also features the return of Francine’s sister Gwen and a chaotic pool incident where Francine takes drastic measures to clear the water.
Metadata.title: Season 22

Metadata.summary: Stan and Francine are upset when Steve reaches puberty. However, Francine wants him to stay young, and Stan wants him to skip puberty and go straight to 21. And both of them use top-secret CIA technology to make sure it happens.
Metadata.title: 1600 Candles

Metadata.summary: Roger plays detective to track down a case of what he suspects is identity theft. Meanwhile, the Smith family gets sucked into a mean game of Simon Says.
Metadata.title: The One That Got Away

Metadata.summary: Bullock makes Stan his "No. 1" at the CIA, a promotion that makes the furious Francine the "No. 1" babysitter for Bullock's baby son. Bullock needs someone to watch the kid because his wife's been kidnapped by Iraqi insurgents.
Metadata.title: One Little Word

Metadata.summary: Stan learns that Francine was engaged to another man before she met him, and tracks the guy down to size him up. Meanwhile, Steve can't stay away from a schizophrenic cat that literally has nine lives.
Metadata.title: Choosey Wives Choose Smith

Metadata.summary: Steve gets revenge on the popular kids at his school after they smear his girlfriend who was running for class president. But he later learns that somebody else was responsible for the attacks, and the popular kids want revenge.
Metadata.title: Escape from Pearl Bailey

Summary.tag: Steve plots his revenge against all the popular girls who torment nerds and losers at his school.

Metadata.summary: Hayley goes on a rampage after her boyfriend breaks up with her, but she calms down when she begins dating Stan's CIA body double, Bill. Meanwhile, Steve and Roger get jobs separating male and female chicks at a Chinatown hatchery.
Metadata.title: Pulling Double Booty

Metadata.summary: Stan emcees a CIA telethon to raise funds for the agency's torture budget after Congress slashed it. But Roger is out to sabotage it because Stan stole the idea for it from him.
Metadata.title: Phantom of the Telethon

Metadata.summary: When Steve suffers indignities in school because of the back brace he must wear for his scoliosis, Stan confides in him that he wears a wig to cover his baldness. Meanwhile, Roger invites both Francine and Hayley to a posh spa even though he has only two passes.
Metadata.title: Chimdale

Metadata.summary: Stan is ecstatic--and energetic--when a coworker gives him pills that allow him to stay up all night.
Metadata.title: Stan Time

Metadata.summary: The Smiths catch Roger spending time with another family--and it turns out that he has been a family "cheater" for decades.
Metadata.title: Family Affair

Metadata.summary: When Langley Falls bans trans fats, Stan and Steve become smugglers. Meanwhile, Klaus gets word that he has received an inheritance but can't collect it because the CIA has turned him into a fish.
Metadata.title: Live and Let Fry

Metadata.summary: When Stan forgets to pick up grenadine at the grocery store, Roger goes ballistic and vows to get him back by taking over a project close to his heart--the Homeowner’s Association.
Metadata.title: Roy Rogers McFreely

Metadata.summary: Steve connects with his ne'er-do-well paternal grandfather, whom Stan despises for many reasons, not the least of which is that he never taught him to ride a bike. Meanwhile, Hayley must find an internship quickly, so Roger hires her to tend his bar.
Metadata.title: Jack's Back

Metadata.summary: Steve and his friends sabotage a stuck-up kid's bar mitzvah after the kid hits on Steve's girlfriend, Debbie. But when Snot is wrongly accused of stealing the kid's bar-mitzvah money, his own bar mitzvah is put in jeopardy.
Metadata.title: Bar Mitzvah Shuffle

Metadata.summary: Francine is upset when she finds out that Stan has a backup wife in place just in case she dies, so she decides to find a backup of her own; Wheels and the Legman investigate the case of Hayley's missing iPod Shuffle.
Metadata.title: Wife Insurance

Metadata.summary: Steve and Stan, who don't have much in common, try to bond on a road trip to Albuquerque in search of a pair of the distinctive DeLorean doors to complete a car that Stan has been building. Meanwhile, Roger, Hayley and Francine decide to have an adventure of their own, but they can't decide what to do.
Metadata.title: Delorean Story-An

Metadata.summary: Steve joins a football team to please Stan, who then takes over as coach and gives Steve the boot because he isn't good enough. Meanwhile, Francine and Hayley vie for a blue ribbon at the county fair.
Metadata.title: Every Which Way But Lose

Metadata.summary: Roger declares that he was sent to Earth to be "the decider" of humanity's fate, and Stan challenges him on it.
Metadata.title: Weiner of Our Discontent

Metadata.summary: Francine and Stan swap spouses with their gay neighbours Terry and Greg when Terry's dad, a former football player who doesn't know that his son is gay, arrives for a visit. Meanwhile, Steve goes on a drunken bender.
Metadata.title: Daddy Queerest

Role.role: Tank Bates / Nelson Mandela / Principal Lewis (voice)

Metadata.summary: Stan leaves Francine at home to go out with the boys, but guys' night out goes from wild to reckless when Stan finds himself in one compromising situation after another. Meanwhile, Roger and Hayley use their charm and looks to attract a frat boy.
Metadata.title: Stan's Night Out
